changelog:
Initial release of geoskill-climate-trend-analysis:

- Provides pixel-wise Mann-Kendall trend test, Sen slope estimation, and OLS linear regression for temperature/precipitation time series.
- Outputs include slope raster (Sen and OLS), significance (p-value) raster, time-series statistics (JSON), and a run manifest.
- Supports both real multi-temporal GeoTIFF input and fully offline synthetic data generation.
- Command line interface with options for variables, bbox, date count, significance level, and quiet mode.
- Runs fully offline by default; no external data or network required.
- Licensed under MIT.
